title: Innokin Klypse Plus Pod Vape Kit
description: The Innokin Klypse Plus Kit takes the celebrated design of the original Klypse and enhances it for vapers who demand serious endurance. Retaining the sleek, buttonless minimalism that made the series famous, the "Plus" integrates a phenomenal 1800mAh built-in battery into its compact aluminium alloy chassis. This significant capacity ensures well over a day of consistent vaping, addressing the common "battery anxiety" associated with compact pod systems. Performance is further enhanced by Innokin’s smart Constant Output Technology. Unlike standard pod kits that lose power as the battery drains, the Klypse Plus delivers a steady voltage to the coil—22W for the 0.6ohm pod, 16W for the 0.8ohm, and 12W for the 1.2ohm. This guarantees that your first puff and your last puff of the day offer the exact same flavour intensity and vapour production. The device utilises a Slider Airflow Control, allowing users to fine-tune their draw from a loose RDL to a tight, cigarette-like MTL. It continues to feature the iconic magnetic dust cap, which keeps the mouthpiece clean when firmly attached and snaps magnetically to the base of the device while you vape so it is never lost. The kit includes the Klypse Pod V2, featuring an advanced mesh coil structure for improved flavour clarity and longevity. Fully cross-compatible, the Klypse Plus works with all Klypse series pods, making it a versatile powerhouse for any MTL vaper. With 2A USB-C fast charging that restores 80% battery in just 30 minutes, the Klypse Plus is the definition of Timeless Style, Tireless Power. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
